objective: Consequences, with exact proof status: the two-bit screening lemma for Fano sides (TWO-BIT-SCREEN A's reduction), equality in the contraction theorem for Fano trees, the touching rule in both directions at distances one and two, and what remains for the source rule.
status: Proved by PENDANT-LINE-20261106-001C-P001: the two-bit screening lemma for Fano sides (an intact Fano side standing in for a line acts as that line for creation); the splitting lemma for atoms attached at points and at lines; exact contraction in spaces built from Fano atoms (a line creates at another exactly when it does in the chain of their atoms); and the touching rule at distances up to two (a line receives creation from another atom at most two away exactly when it touches its atom's cut toward it), so the brace dictionary up to distance two is a theorem and every cut is read in its direction; what remains for the source rule is a transfer along chains of four or more atoms
